I've replied to Dana in your DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from Dana's own messages in #north-team on 2025-08-20. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180." I couldn't check it against the signed amendment because no Quarrendon contract files are visible to her in the share. I suggested she use the signed copy she sent June Osei-Lark if the deck needs to cite the document itself.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
